body: The first-aid kit and the water bottle are tied in one bundle with torn warning tape. A numbered tag hangs from the kit's handle, and a sticker is pressed over the bottle cap.
title: First-aid kit and water bottle, the second evening

body: The old man had no part in the farm trial, yet a yellow rim formed around his water pail after the storm. He kept the first pail for washing and gave guests the second. The stream comes down from the same treated slope.
title: Seed dust in the shelter
